div.div: أَرْضٌ مُؤَرْنِبَةٌ A land in which are أَرَانِب [or hares]: (S:) or abounding therewith; (T, Kr, M, and so in some copies of the K;) as also ↓ مُؤَرْنَبَةٌ , (M, and so in some copies of the K, and in a copy of the A,) and ↓ مَرْنَبَةٌ . (T, M, A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
